As of September 8, 2026, the latest good news from Wolfgang is his excitement about the upcoming music jam session with a fellow musician, LiHua, and their band. He has shared that the progress of his software project has been significant, thanks to LiHua's support during challenging times. Wolfgang is looking forward to showcasing his progress in the next jam session and has been practicing with a new song, "Come Together," as well as the Beatles' classic "Here Comes the Sun," ready to bring energy to their Sunday gathering. Wolfgang expresses anticipation for the jam session, envisioning a blasting session with the band where they create and enjoy music together.
